samples: This program defines a library for working with plane shapes—circles, rectangles, and points—and calculates their areas using a simple approximation. It provides functions to describe individual shapes with their measurements and to find the largest shape in a list. When run, it demonstrates these capabilities by printing descriptions of sample shapes and identifying which one has the greatest area.
